description: This PHP trait provides helper methods for installer commands in the OrangeHRM system, including input validation, system check display, and password validation.

methods.name: getRequiredField
methods.description: Prompts the user for a required input field with optional validation.

methods.name: requiredValidator
methods.description: Validates that the answer is not null or empty, throws exception if invalid.

methods.name: databasePortValidator
methods.description: Validates that the port number is within 0-65535 or empty.

methods.name: alphanumericValidator
methods.description: Validates that the input contains only alphanumeric characters and underscores.

methods.name: emailValidator
methods.description: Validates that the input is a valid email address.

methods.name: phoneNumberValidator
methods.description: Validates that the input is a valid phone number format.

methods.name: hasOption
methods.description: Checks if a command-line option is provided and non-empty.

methods.name: drawSystemCheckTable
methods.description: Displays a table summarizing system check results with color-coded statuses.

methods.name: startSection
methods.description: Starts a new console output section with a step label.

methods.name: startStep
methods.description: Updates console section with current step message.

methods.name: completeStep
methods.description: Marks a step as completed in the console output.

methods.name: validateStrLength
methods.description: Ensures string does not exceed specified length.

methods.name: validatePassword
methods.description: Checks password strength and policies, throws exception if policies are not met.
